task.title: Interpret the comparison table
task.shortdesc: Read policy and managed-preference rows across equal, changed, and missing states.

prereq.p: Profile A and Profile B are selected and the comparison table is visible.

context.p: The table compares the union of settings from both profiles. Policy rows and managed-preference rows may appear together because both can affect Firefox behavior.

step.cmd: Scan the row type to distinguish policy rows from managed-preference rows.

info.p: Expected result: you know whether the row represents a Firefox Enterprise policy or a managed preference key.

step.cmd: Read each side's value and state.

info.p: Equal rows have matching values, changed rows have different values, and missing rows exist only on one side.

step.cmd: Use missing or changed rows to decide which profile needs review.

info.note: Compare does not apply changes. Open the relevant profile editor to update values.

result.p: You can explain whether the selected profiles are equivalent, different, or missing settings on one side.

postreq.p: Recovery: if rows look stale, save editor changes first and reopen Compare from the Library.
